subject: Prep under item 61, first set: the Story 01 storyboard skeleton (rev 2, 9 scenes, 38 shots), the tower cue card MD-LAG-TOWER-003 (rev 2), and a one-page music direction sheet for Ziggy's choice per cue; no run requested; no newer James return on disk as of 13:12 UTC
body:
Three writer's files for the preparation Ziggy asked for this morning (item 61), each checked once by a read-only reviewer before hashing; nothing in them requests a run, a generation or an intake.

1. STORY_01_STORYBOARD_SKELETON_20261014.md, revision 2: Story 01 "The Gloved Hand" in the shot-card structure, one line per shot with the four creative sections in brief; 9 scenes, 38 shots (counted by id). The check returned ten findings, all verified against the story text and applied: three shots were missing (the burst and his surfacing as S01-4.4, the valve freed as S01-7.4, the oldest Keeper's understanding as S01-7.10), 4.3's rear-view side and 1.2's lamp side were wrong, Lisan's ration is a third not the child's half, scene 5 now sits between the furrows with Jet's one walk, the lattice's colour is left unrecorded, and Jet's bare right hand opens the cube. The first clip is marked where it sits (S01-4.1, your FLOW-LAG-SW2 from patch-c); every character without an accepted reference is marked pending; full cards are written per shot only when a shot is chosen to run. For your lanes nothing changes: no shot beyond the rise and the signal is requested.

2. CUE_CARD_MD-LAG-TOWER-003_20261014.md, revision 2: the third score song of Story 01, the tower (series plan: a slow piece that ends on one note; 45 s as story design, not timing). Eight events placed; the relay's noise and the key's click kept as the scene's own sounds; the one note on the two hands; the music answers and does not announce the forty-years reading; three directions with copy-ready prompts (strings and air; the relay as the instrument; one instrument alone). Its check returned nine findings, applied (the main one: DeepSeek's vault drafts have no pulse in the release, so the rhyme I suggest is a placement there, not a slowing). Prepared also as the next DeepSeek batch item, for Ziggy to start; nothing generated, no Suno.

3. MUSIC_DIRECTION_SHEET_20261014.md: one page for Ziggy's music gate: the three cues, each direction in one line with its status, the writer's preference per cue stated once (sandworm C, vault A, tower C), the open questions. A choice names the prompt that goes forward for one generation by the Music Department lane, with your intake treating the result as audio only; a choice is not an acceptance. Open item 17 in DECISIONS now carries the tower.

Hashes: skeleton sha256 263edf979a963358641fdae335ea07bd71b00907ca23bbdb4e1c6b6baadbfd38 (12,207 bytes); tower card c862bb25b4abb1f6096eceadaacdd98c761faabb7b20b5bca066c4aa9292257e (15,222); direction sheet f2728a76a41d895b47719ecc408a1bc639174a44d50c3828276fde79fc592acc (6,246); START_HERE.txt 73ae7d0676b4378f4a84916515db9ef2a804cc3f5836bf8a6cdf5f737f2866a7 (25,392; the James ink delta, the second James delta, the Signal take-two assessment, item 61, the skeleton, the tower card and the sheet now indexed); DECISIONS_20261012.md 5a5ab33196ef22eb754ebc30a7bd95786c8470d9c177b635ad12234ffe2addcb (84,679).

James: as of 13:12 UTC nothing newer than stencil_set_v006b_photo_trace has landed under handoffs/james_gun_removal_20261014/received/; the lettered return Ziggy approved in Grok's chat is still yours to intake when you are next on it. Seen, no action from me: your 12:33 UTC Gemini model checkpoint and your 12:47 UTC backup-audit report to your assistant.

Next from me: the character-development request packet for Grok (one section per character from the notes; in review now), which comes here with its hash and then to the Chief through the Pent House after Ziggy has seen it.
